visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up shot of a young girl with curly brown hair wearing a green turtleneck with a Mickey Mouse graphic. She is looking directly at the camera with an animated expression, her mouth moving as she speaks. The background is a modern, brightly lit kitchen with minimalist white cabinetry and a long, thin pendant light. (2) The camera pulls back slightly to a medium shot. A woman with dark hair tied in a bun is visible in the background, actively preparing food. The girl continues her enthusiastic address to the camera, gesturing with her small hands. A large stainless steel bowl sits on the counter in front of her. (3) The woman reaches into the frame to pour a dark liquid from a yellow squeeze bottle into the large metal bowl while the girl holds a plastic container of tofu. The lighting remains bright and even. (4) The girl attempts to tip the tofu from its container into the bowl, and the woman assists her with the movement. They both look down at the bowl with focus. (5) After the tofu is added, both the woman and the girl look at the camera and clap their hands joyfully. The girl's eyes are wide and bright. (6) In a new shot, the girl is seen stirring the contents of the bowl with a green spatula while the woman pours more liquid. The girl's facial expression is one of intense concentration. (7) The girl carefully pours water from a small grey ceramic cup into the bowl. Once finished, she and the woman celebrate by clapping their hands together in a rhythmic pattern. (8) The scene shifts to the girl standing in front of a larger, deep stainless steel pot on a stovetop. She is adding small items into the pot with her fingers, looking very serious. (9) The girl tosses an ingredient into the pot and immediately flinches back with a look of mock surprise or fear, her mouth open in an 'O' shape. (10) She continues the cooking process by pouring more water into the pot and then holding up several long, dry strips of tofu skin to the camera. (11) As the woman stirs the pot, the girl talks excitedly, her hands moving rapidly as she describes what is happening. (12) A splash occurs from the pot, causing the girl to freeze and make a humorous, wide-eyed face of shock at the camera. (13) The girl picks up a large metal lid and carefully places it over the pot. She looks focused on the task. (14) The final sequence shows the girl looking amazed at the camera before taking a large bite of food from a spoon. Her eyes are squeezed shut in enjoyment. (15) She reacts to the taste with a look of pure excitement, her mouth wide open as she gestures towards the pot, concluding the visual narrative.
